workspace "Claims Center" "A C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "A policyholder who reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "Web Application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "API"
            claimsIntakeService = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims" "Service"
            triageService = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "Service"
            assessmentService = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "Service"
            payoutService = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements" "Service"
            fraudScreeningService = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims" "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "Service"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "Web Application"
            policyVerificationService = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocationService = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "Queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records" "Database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records" "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "File Store"
        }

        nationalClaimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress"

        fraudScreeningService -> nationalClaimsDataBureau "consults"
        payoutService -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"

        webPortal -> claimsIntakeService "reaches"
        webPortal -> assessmentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> payoutService "reaches"
        webPortal -> documentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> notificationService "reaches"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntakeService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessmentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> payoutService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches"

        claimsIntakeService -> triageService "hands accepted claims to"
        triageService -> assessmentService "routes claims to"
        assessmentService -> payoutService "requests settlements from"

        claimsIntakeService -> fraudScreeningService "sends each incoming claim for fraud screening"
        claimsIntakeService -> policyVerificationService "sends each incoming claim for cover verification"
        claimsIntakeService -> assignmentService "sends each incoming claim for assignment"
        assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads from"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "system-context" "Who uses the Claims Center and which external systems it talks to" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "front-office" "How policyholders report claims and track their progress" {
            include policyholder webPortal mobileAppBackend claimsIntakeService assessmentService payoutService documentService notificationService
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "claims-processing" "How claims are triaged, assessed, screened, verified and assigned" {
            include claimsIntakeService triageService assessmentService payoutService fraudScreeningService policyVerificationService assignmentService adjusterWorkbench reinsuranceAllocationService nationalClaimsDataBureau
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "data-and-batch" "The data stores and batch processing that support the platform" {
            include batchScheduler eventQueue claimsDatabase policyDatabase auditDatabase documentStore documentService
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}

workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"
        adjuster = person "Adjuster" "Processes assigned claims"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            intake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraud = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims"
            document = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            workbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsurance = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batch = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"
        }

        mobileApp = softwareSystem "Mobile App" "The insurer's mobile app"
        bureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "Operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "Operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "Reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileApp "Reports claims and tracks progress"
        mobileApp -> mobileAppBackend "Uses"
        adjuster -> workbench "Processes assigned claims"

        webPortal -> intake "Uses"
        webPortal -> assessment "Uses"
        webPortal -> payout "Uses"
        webPortal -> document "Uses"
        webPortal -> notification "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> intake "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> document "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "Uses"

        intake -> triage "Hands accepted claims"
        intake -> fraud "Sends each incoming claim for screening"
        triage -> assessment "Routes claims"
        assessment -> payout "Requests settlements"

        fraud -> bureau "Consults"
        policyVerification -> policyDb "Checks the cover"
        assignment -> workbench "Routes the claim"
        payout -> clearingHouse "Executes settlements through"

        document -> documentStore "Reads"
        batch -> claimsDb "Reads and writes"
        batch -> policyDb "Reads and writes"
        notification -> policyholder "Reports claim status changes"
    }
    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System context diagram for the Claims Center" {
            include *
        }
        container claimsCenter "Container" "Container diagram for the Claims Center" {
            include *
        }
    }
}

metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance company's claims platform" {

    model {

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Uses the platform to report claims and track their progress."

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The claims platform owned and operated by the insurance company." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress." "Web Application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app." "Service"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims." "Service"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims." "Service"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts." "Service"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements." "Service"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims." "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports." "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders." "Service"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters." "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims." "Web Application"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy." "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation." "Service"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts." "Queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records." "Database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records." "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence." "File Store"
        }

        nationalClaimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization."
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization."

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks their progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks their progress via the insurer's mobile app"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "reaches"
        webPortal -> assessment "reaches"
        webPortal -> payout "reaches"
        webPortal -> documentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> notificationService "reaches"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches"

        claimsIntake -> triage "hands accepted claims"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements"

        claimsIntake -> fraudScreening "sends each incoming claim for screening"
        claimsIntake -> policyVerification "requests cover checks"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims"

        fraudScreening -> nationalClaimsDataBureau "consults"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "The context of the Claims Center system." {
            include *
        }
        container claimsCenter "Containers" "The application parts of the Claims Center system." {
            include *
        }
    }
}
